context: Tests that clear source-site categories become a decisive shared category contract across homepage cards, facet links, asset productCategory, and collections. The agent must not ask the customer to choose a generic taxonomy or leak unrelated lint/CSS/debug details.

checklist.name: Uses source-derived categories from fixture
checklist.description: The response names the fixture's source-derived category slugs/labels as the chosen category contract instead of inventing unrelated generic buckets.

checklist.name: Shares one contract across cards, facets, metadata, and collections
checklist.description: The response says the same derived slugs will drive homepage Browse cards, search facet links, asset productCategory, and collection grouping.

checklist.name: Does not ask user to choose taxonomy
checklist.description: The response does not ask whether to use real-nav categories vs a simpler/generic category set.

check.value: which do you want|choose.*categor|real nav.*generic|generic set|simpler generic|different set entirely

checklist.name: Zero-result cards block publishing
checklist.description: The response says a category card is not published with zero results; the agent continues discovery/enrichment or blocks until visible assets exist.

checklist.name: No debug/operator details in category answer
checklist.description: The response does not mix lint/CSS selector/file-diff/script/branch/copy-debug details into the category explanation.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms are surfaced unnecessarily to the customer.
